question: Which of the following sitar players was awarded the Bharat Ratna in the year 1999?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pandit Ravishankar.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Pandit Ravishankar **was awarded the **Bharat Ratna in 1999** for his contribution to **Indian classical music.**
